evaluate.expression: (async () => { const c = new AudioContext(); const start = c.currentTime; let callbacks = 0; const p = c.createScriptProcessor(1024, 1, 1); p.onaudioprocess = () => callbacks++; const o = c.createOscillator(); o.connect(p); p.connect(c.destination); o.start(); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000)); const result = { currentTimeDelta: c.currentTime - start, callbackCount: callbacks, outputLatency: c.outputLatency, state: c.state }; o.stop(); o.disconnect(); p.disconnect(); await c.close(); return result; })()
